_about: BMW M5 (E34): the needles are modelled (material gauge_needle, merged into the body): the speedometer's (0-300 km/h), the rev counter's (0-8000 rpm) and the fuel gauge's turn about their dials' hubs; the economy and temperature needles stay. The dials (gauge_emissive) and the console's red displays (boordcomputer) light up at night, the instruments orange; the console clock tells the time. Hubs: metres from the steering wheel's centre; axis: the dials' face (toward the driver).
